Bay Area Christmas DJ – Holiday Party Questions & Answers
When should I book my Bay Area Christmas DJ?
Christmas is December 25th, 2026 (Friday), but most parties happen throughout December and into January. Book early to secure your date for corporate holiday parties, Christmas Eve events, Hanukkah celebrations, and New Year’s Eve. Call us today at 1-415-350-5474 to reserve your spot!
What kind of music do you play at Christmas parties?
We play all your favorite holiday classics including:
  • Mariah Carey – “All I Want For Christmas Is You”
  • Nat King Cole – “The Christmas Song”
  • Jose Feliciano – “Feliz Navidad”
  • Brenda Lee – “Rockin’ Around The Christmas Tree”
  • Bing Crosby – “White Christmas”
  • John Lennon – “Happy Xmas (War Is Over)”
  • Hanukkah favorites by Adam Sandler and more
Plus festive tunes for all holiday gatherings including Christmas Eve, Hanukkah, and New Year’s parties.
Do you provide special effects for holiday parties?
Yes! Enhance your party with:
  • Photo Booths & LED Uplighting
  • Low Laying Dry Ice Fog
  • Snowflake Light Projections
  • Snow Machine Packages
Ask us about discounts for weekday and Friday Christmas events.
Can you handle corporate holiday and employee parties?
Absolutely! We specialize in Bay Area corporate Christmas and year-end holiday parties. Our DJs are professional, experienced, and ready to create a fun and festive atmosphere with music and interactive entertainment suitable for all ages and company cultures.
How do I book my Bay Area Christmas DJ?
Booking is simple:
  • Call 1-415-350-5474 to speak with a party planner
  • Submit your booking request online via our Holiday Party DJ Request Form
  • Ask about special holiday packages and discounts
Don’t wait — holiday dates fill up fast!
